quotes.name: Export factoring, non-recourse (bank)
quotes.requirements: Invoice to an insured or creditworthy foreign buyer; assignment notified to the debtor. A non-recourse factor does not buy an invoice whose debtor has already announced a delay.
quotes.rate_reference: Public Chilean ranges 2026: non-recourse 1.5%-2.2%/month, with recourse 1.2%-1.8%/month (chita.cl, simpli.cl); low end because the buyer is insured

quotes.name: Pre-export loan in USD (PAE)
quotes.requirements: Export contract or shipping documents; repaid in USD with the export proceeds.
quotes.rate_reference: CMF certificate 09/2026: foreign-currency bank average 10.26%/yr (up to 2,000 UF) and 5.78%/yr (above); Term SOFR + exporter spread
quotes.note: cost of the full contract term

quotes.name: Working capital loan (default bank credit)
quotes.requirements: Two years of financial statements; collateral or personal guarantee.
quotes.rate_reference: CMF certificate 09/2026: bank average 20.06%/yr (90 days or more, 200-5,000 UF) and 33.34%/yr (under 90 days, up to 5,000 UF). We use 14% (a collateralized exporter with a good record), which makes the default loan cheaper and our savings conservative

quotes.name: Credit line / overdraft
quotes.requirements: Pre-approved line on the current account.
quotes.rate_reference: 2.1%/month = 25.2%/yr, under the CMF short-term average of 33.34%/yr (certificate 09/2026)

quotes.name: Fintech factoring, with recourse (fast onboarding)
quotes.requirements: Online onboarding; funds in 24 h. With recourse: if the buyer has not paid 30 days after the expected date, the exporter repays the advance.
quotes.rate_reference: Fintech rate cards 2026 (Xepelin 0.5%-1.8%, GoCapital 0.6%-2.0%, Crecer 0.8%-2.2% per month; portalinnova.cl)

quotes.name: Confirming (supplier payment extension)
quotes.requirements: Supplier enrolled in the bank's confirming program.
quotes.rate_reference: Bank confirming programs; below the CMF short-term average because the risk is the buyer's (our SME)

quotes.name: FOGAPE-guaranteed working capital loan
quotes.requirements: Net annual sales up to 100,000 UF (medium firms 25,001-100,000 UF get 50% guarantee coverage); financing up to 15,000 UF; no protests or overdue debts.
quotes.rate_reference: FOGAPE rules (CORFO / BancoEstado administrator); rate below the unguaranteed loan because half the risk is state-guaranteed
quotes.note: cost of the full contract term

quotes.name: CNY forward (sell CNY, cash-settled)
quotes.requirements: FX framework agreement (contrato marco) with the bank; notional up to the hedged receivable.
quotes.reason: hedge: no cash, reduces CNY downside
quotes.rate_reference: Covered interest parity CLP vs CNY + bank spread

quotes.name: Letter of credit discounting
quotes.requirements: Only receivables backed by a confirmed documentary letter of credit.
quotes.reason: every eligible invoice is collected before the need date
quotes.rate_reference: Bank trade-finance price lists (SOFR + spread, converted to a monthly discount)

catalog_status: REFERENCE VALUES, NOT QUOTES. Lenders are fictional. Loan rates are anchored to the CMF interest-rate certificate 09/2026 (bank averages for August 2026) and set below the market average on purpose, so the savings we report against the bank loan are conservative. Factoring rates come from public Chilean rate ranges. See docs/financial-catalog.md for every source.
